items.title: Dave Brubeck — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: The interviewer mentions Sakharov in the context of a room with Gorbachev and Reagan, but the interviewee (Dave Brubeck) does not respond or confirm any personal interaction or relationship with Sakharov.

ctx.x: With Gorbachev and Reagan. I had a few things come to mind: a room where Garbechev had just made life a lot easier for poets and musicians or political people that had been sent to Siberia. Sitting next to Iola was a general in the Russian Army. Here these people – I wish I could remember the scientist’s name. Or the wife. He was such an important scientist, but he’d been ostracized.
Was that it Iola? Say that again.
